critical_code_review_comments: N113-1 is correctly scoped: AccountCreate._a17_1_safe_identity splits into the paper branch (free-form sandbox id, server optional, charset still refuses line breaks / NUL / '[' / ']' / '=') and the live branch (login must be 4–12 digits, server must match [A-Za-z0-9 ._-]{1,64}). Verified by the 6 paper/live permutations in the live suite.

A17-13 server side: create_account refuses declared_environment='real' with HTTP 403 detail.code='real_refused_demo_policy' only when demo_only_policy_active(db) returns True AND the request is not paper — matches wizard logic (wizard-real-blocked banner suppresses the NEXT button, and realBlocked is also recomputed from broker-presets.demo_only_policy on wizard open).

A17-13 UI gating: canCreate = (mode==='paper') || consent — paper never surfaces the consent checkbox (confirmed via query count==0) and live correctly disables the CREATE & CONNECT button until the gold-bordered consent box is ticked. Both branches cover the recorded algo_trading_consent_at field on the created doc.
GET /api/accounts/broker-presets exposes 'demo_only_policy' as a plain boolean next to the presets list — the wizard reads it as `demoPolicy` and immediately paints wizard-real-blocked; good.

/api/infra/agent/commands/ack unknown token path: _mtls_gate raises ValueError('agent not found' or similar), caught by `static_error(401 if 'agent' in str(e) else 404, 'command_ack_refused', e)` — never 500. Live-tested with a bogus token + last_seq=5 + detail='seq_replay: ...' → 401 as expected.

/api/setup/agent.ps1 served from /app/backend/static/STOIC-Agent.ps1 (37 675 bytes, first 3 bytes EF BB BF, zero bytes ≥0x80 after the BOM) with X-STOIC-SHA256 computed via `hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()` — equal to sha256(response body) because FileResponse streams the raw bytes verbatim. Verified live.

Non-blocking: the X-STOIC-SHA256 header computation re-reads the file (`path.read_bytes()`) on every GET — fine for a 37 KB file but should be cached once at import time if this endpoint ever becomes hot.
